newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chips rise, sending Dow to record.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chips rise, sending Dow to record.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks rose Friday, propelling the Dow Jones industrial average to a record.
Based on early and unofficial data, the 30-share Dow average added 14.23 points to close at 6,560.91. That surpasses the record of 6,547.79 set on Nov. 25.
In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a 15-9 margin on light volume of about 255 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
